prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: square 1024x1024 Cafe Collection collectible card artwork, one featured drink.
Scene/backdrop: a modest South Indian coffee-house tabletop with muted stone and warm wood, soft window daylight.
Primary request: freshly brewed South Indian filter coffee with milk, served in a small stainless-steel davara tumbler set. One polished cylindrical metal tumbler filled with rich light-brown coffee and a fine layer of froth sits inside a shallow stainless-steel saucer-like davara; both vessels completely visible, a little steam, realistic coffee surface and reflections. Close three-quarter editorial food photograph, tactile understated realism, shallow depth of field.
Constraints: no people, no hands, no text, logos, labels, flags, borders, watermark or collage. No tea bags, espresso cup, latte art, giant mug or coffee beans as the main subject.
